lines.text: 3 AM in Miami. The water is already under your door.
In ten seconds, it's at your waist.
The door won't open. The window won't break.
One breath left. Find the hatch.
Air. But the attic is flooding too.
So you punch through the roof.
A boat on the left. A helicopter above.
But the roof is cracking. You only get one shot.
Comment your choice. Part two decides if you live.
